rapport_notes: Warm through discovery and pricing, but no attempt was made to handle the price objection at the end.

evidence_quotes.agenda: 'before that, I just wanna ask are there any important concerns that you want us to discuss over this call as well aside from the quotation' — asked before any item-level logistics probing.
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Customer asked the rep to confirm disassembly/reassembly service; rep answered fully ('the guys will have all the tools they need... we can reassemble it for you as well') then pivoted straight to itemizing the move, no further digging.
evidence_quotes.save_your_ass: 'if it takes shorter than that, that's totally fine, you only pay for how long it takes after the two and a half hour minimum.'

top_strength: Nailed the agenda/concerns question early and gave a well-personalized estimate anchor tied to the specific furniture list.
coaching_note: When the customer cited a competitor's $750 quote, no attempt was made to defend the estimate or handle the objection before the call ended — that was the moment this call needed a save.
